title: Pimax HMD Display Stays Black
shortDescription: Pimax detected by software but display does not light.
fullDescription: Pimax 5K/8K/Crystal often need DisplayPort 1.4 directly into GPU and PiTool installed. Black display usually means handshake failure.

fixSteps.title: Reseat DP
fixSteps.instruction: Plug into native DP 1.4 on GPU, no adapters.

fixSteps.title: Restart PiTool
fixSteps.instruction: Right-click tray, exit PiTool, relaunch as admin.

fixSteps.title: Lower refresh
fixSteps.instruction: Set 72Hz in PiTool to ease bandwidth.

faq.a: Some Crystals support it; classic Pimax requires DP.

title: PiTool Refuses to Install
fullDescription: PiTool installer requires .NET runtime and admin rights. Antivirus often blocks driver signing prompt.

fixSteps.title: Disable AV
fixSteps.instruction: Temporarily disable real-time protection during install.

faq.a: Crystal uses Pimax Play; older HMDs use PiTool.

title: Pimax Tracking Jitters
shortDescription: View shakes slightly even when still.
fullDescription: Lighthouse jitter on Pimax often relates to USB power management or 1.0/2.0 base station mismatch.

title: Pimax IPD Adjustment Motor Stuck
shortDescription: Motorized IPD does not move on Crystal.
fullDescription: Crystal IPD motor can stick. Use Pimax Play to recalibrate, or open headset to free the rail.

faq.a: Pimax Play has manual mm input.

title: Pimax Headset Overheats
fullDescription: QLED panels in Crystal run warm. Ensure DMAS cooling fan if equipped, and avoid covering vents.

fixSteps.title: Free vents
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure top vent unobstructed by cushion.

title: Index Controllers Won't Pair to Pimax
shortDescription: Knuckles don't connect via SteamVR dongle.
fullDescription: Pimax users often pair Valve Index Knuckles. Pairing requires SteamVR dongles plugged into PC USB hub at least 1m apart.

causes.cause: Dongle too close to other Bluetooth

fixSteps.title: Use USB extension
fixSteps.instruction: Place dongles 1m apart on extension cables.

faq.a: Sword controllers exist but most use Knuckles.

title: Wide FOV Edge Distortion
shortDescription: Curved or warped image at edges.
fullDescription: Pimax 200 deg FOV has parallax projection options. Switch to Normal or Small FOV with PP off to reduce edge distortion.

fixSteps.title: Enable Parallel Projection
fixSteps.instruction: PiTool > Parallel Projection On for affected games.

title: Pimax Cable Develops Fault
fullDescription: Pimax 5-in-1 cable is fragile at HMD strain relief. Twisting or sharp bends cause flicker or disconnects.

fixSteps.title: Tape strain relief
fixSteps.instruction: Wrap cable to backstrap to relieve strain.

fixSteps.title: Replace cable
fixSteps.instruction: Order replacement Pimax cable, swap on HMD.

title: Visible God Rays / Glare
fullDescription: Fresnel lenses produce god rays. Pancake lenses on Crystal reduce them. Cleaning lenses also helps.

fixSteps.title: Use anti-glare diffuser
fixSteps.instruction: Some users add lens diffuser stickers.

faq.a: Crystal pancake reduces god rays significantly.

title: Smart Smoothing Causes Microstutter
shortDescription: SteamVR motion smoothing produces hitches on Pimax.
fullDescription: Smart Smoothing on wide FOV causes more reprojection artifacts than narrow FOV headsets. Manually cap to half-rate or disable.

fixSteps.title: Force 1/2 rate
fixSteps.instruction: SteamVR settings > Video > Per-Application > Force half-rate Smart Smoothing.
